questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Wi-Fi station and access point”?
options: ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
questions.explanation:
WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA) selects station mode.
Why: Station mode joins a router; access point mode creates a local network. Manage reconnects with a state machine and keep network work from blocking control tasks.
